verdict: No paid activity this period; organic presence is holding but softening.
narrative: Your paid channels — Meta and Google — recorded zero spend and zero leads across the full 28 days, so all engagement this period came from your Google Business Profile and organic web traffic. Your profile generated 56 actions (33 direction requests, 22 website clicks, 1 call), though that activity dropped 21% in the most recent week and reached zero in the last three days, signaling that local profile visibility is quietly fading without paid support behind it. Website sessions showed a mid-period spike — up 50% week-over-week — but that reversed just as quickly, averaging only 4 sessions per day in the last three days versus 11 the week before. With no paid campaigns running, there is no lead pipeline to report. The immediate priority is restoring paid activity so the business has a consistent, controllable source of new leads.
